evidence_gaps_closed.title: The Phase-5 CI gate was green and published no evidence at all
evidence_gaps_closed.finding: The exact-head Phase-5 workflow reported success for all four milestones while producing NO GitHub artifact. Three independent causes: the evidence staging directory is dot-prefixed and actions/upload-artifact@v4 silently skips hidden files; if-no-files-found was set to 'warn', which demoted 'the evidence does not exist' to a log line nobody reads; and nothing assembled or checked the evidence before uploading it. A green run with no artifact is indistinguishable from a green run whose evidence was never produced.
evidence_gaps_closed.resolution: Publication is now fail-closed. scripts/ci/phase5_evidence.py assembles the artifact from files the gate's own runners wrote and REFUSES to publish a partial one -- a missing env record, a missing required step outcome, or a missing/typeless machine count each exit non-zero. The upload sets include-hidden-files, if-no-files-found: error and a 90-day retention, and is named for the head under test. A final step reads the upload action's own artifact-id and artifact-digest outputs back and fails the job if either is absent, so 'there is a downloadable artifact with this ID and this digest' is a measurement rather than an assumption.
evidence_gaps_closed.counter_proof: scripts/ci/phase5-evidence-selftest.sh drives the REAL assembler (never a copy) against a complete staging directory and against six deliberately damaged ones, and fails if it accepts any of them. It runs FIRST in the workflow, before any gate can make the staging directory look complete. 9/9 locally.
evidence_gaps_closed.a_gate_that_only_passes: The self-test exists because a fail-closed component that has only ever been watched succeeding has not been shown to fail closed. The control case is included precisely so the six refusals cannot all be passing for the trivial reason that the assembler refuses everything.

evidence_gaps_closed.title: The LIVE-DARK health check never covered pmsd
evidence_gaps_closed.finding: The deployment's service-health loop covered scd, edged, netd and acctd and said nothing about pmsd, the dedicated PMS connector. Its posture was therefore unmeasured on the very appliance whose darkness the deployment claims.
evidence_gaps_closed.resolution: A pmsd DARK-contract criterion was added to scripts/phase5-iam-live-dark-deploy.sh, deliberately OUTSIDE the is-active loop. pmsd is the one StayConnect daemon that is healthy when dead: with no Phase-3 flag set, LoadPMSConfigFromEnv resolves every flag OFF and pmsd.Run returns immediately without loading an assignment, building a database pool, decrypting a secret, starting a worker or opening a PMS socket. The criterion measures that contract in six arms -- installed and enabled (not missing or masked); inactive/dead by way of Result=success and exit 0 (a crash is also 'not running'); no restart storm (NRestarts=0, exactly one start this boot, zero storm indicators); the daemon's OWN journal statement that it took the flags-OFF path and stopped cleanly; no process and no socket belonging to it; and no database backend attributable to it.
evidence_gaps_closed.explicitly_not_done: The criterion does NOT require a live PMS worker. Demanding 'active' would have exactly two outcomes: it fails a correct appliance, or somebody makes it green by starting a live connector -- real PMS traffic that no Phase-5 authorization covers.
evidence_gaps_closed.measured: On the development appliance radius (172.21.60.23): LoadState=loaded, UnitFileState=enabled, inactive (dead), Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0, NRestarts=0, starts-this-boot=1, storm-indicators=0, the dark statement and the clean stop both present in this boot's journal, 0 processes, 0 sockets, 0 attributable database backends.
evidence_gaps_closed.counter_proof: PHASE5_PMSD_UNIT exists so the criterion can be shown to FAIL, and defaults to the real unit. Pointed at stayconnect-scd it aborts on the active-state arm; pointed at stayconnect-ctrlapi it aborts on the enabled arm. The remaining four arms were demonstrated at the predicate level against real appliance data that violates them (a unit with no pmsd start line, no dark statement, a running service user with 209 processes and 7 sockets, and the same database query shape with a pattern that matches 12 live backends). No enabled-and-inactive substitute unit exists on this appliance, so those four were not demonstrated end-to-end through the script.
